About the artist

A woman, painted
as a mirror.

I am an artist who sees painting as a way to speak what is hard to say out loud — my story, my pain — carried through the image of a woman. She is not one person. She is whoever is looking at her.

Every canvas starts the same way: blue, like a held breath, and a figure who hasn't decided yet whether to open her eyes. The blindfold, the pearls, the handprints pressed into the paint by hand — each mark is left visible on purpose. Nothing is smoothed over. That's the point.

“ The paint is textured because the story is. I don't sand it down.

Recurring motif
The blindfolded woman

In progress

The studio, mid-story.

Most of the work happens close in — leaning into wet paint, mixing colour directly on the palette, building up the handprints layer by layer until the canvas feels crowded the way memory does.

Commissions open

Start a piece
that's yours.

A commission usually starts with a conversation, not a brief. Tell me the story you want carried, and we'll work out the rest together.

  1. 1 Enquire — share the story and the space it's for
  2. 2 Consult — we talk it through, size and palette included
  3. 3 Deposit — 50% to begin, secures your place in the queue
  4. 4 Progress — process photos as the piece builds
  5. 5 Delivery — collection or courier once fully cured
